description: Power System Simulation Toolbox (PSST), published by ames-market, implements security-constrained unit commitment and economic dispatch for the day-ahead and real-time markets of AMES, using Python and Pyomo. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): AMES License (BSD-2-Clause style, Battelle). The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support optimisation, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Licence: AMES License (permissive, Battelle; see repository), read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources. The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
